name: Cloudflare Security Audit
description: Investigate security vulnerabilities with evidence and independent verification.
why: Investigate security vulnerabilities with evidence and independent verification.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: Full audits need Node, parallel agents, and a tightly isolated sandbox; they write audit artifacts. If sandbox controls are unavailable, findings need validation.

name: Trail of Bits Property-Based Testing
description: Find counterexamples by testing properties across generated inputs.
why: Find counterexamples by testing properties across generated inputs.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: May require a property-testing library such as fast-check, Hypothesis, or proptest; the installer does not add one.

name: Emil Animation Performance
description: Diagnose dropped frames and animation rendering costs.
why: Diagnose dropped frames and animation rendering costs.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: Profile actual devices and browsers before applying generalized performance advice.

name: Emil Mobile Native
description: Improve touch, viewport, safe-area, and mobile web behavior.
why: Improve touch, viewport, safe-area, and mobile web behavior.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: Some checks require a physical phone; apply interaction defaults to the product context.

name: Emil Break UI
description: Stress-test interfaces with realistic long, empty, and unusual data.
why: Stress-test interfaces with realistic long, empty, and unusual data.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: Creates a development-only data toggle and reports problems before asking about fixes.

name: Matt Diagnosing Bugs
description: Build a repeatable failure and test hypotheses for difficult bugs.
why: Build a repeatable failure and test hypotheses for difficult bugs.

setup.label: Setup
setup.detail: May ask for help when it cannot reproduce a failure; includes an optional Bash script.

name: Trail of Bits Differential Review
description: Review a code change for security regressions and downstream impact.
why: Combines change-focused analysis with security context and evidence.

setup.label: Manual setup
setup.detail: Install the differential-review plugin using the upstream instructions. Its high-risk workflow references a plugin-specific adversarial-modeler agent outside the skill folder.

setup.label: Report
setup.detail: The workflow writes a Markdown report and may use Git commands and subagents.

cautions: The full plugin and its agent require a supported harness; check upstream setup.
